# CANDIDATE: OVERNIGHT_GRINDER_V14_V15_TOP_COMBO

**Filed:** 2026-07-22
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** exit_change
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Adjusting exit parameters (stops, targets) and level position sizing to better capture the 5/04 winner while minimizing losses on loser days. The hypothesis is that wider stops and higher TP1 for SUPER setups, combined with increased level contracts, will improve edge capture on volatile winner days without increasing loser-day losses.

## Mechanism

Entry logic remains unchanged (v14/v15 structure). Exit logic modified:
- SUPER setups: stop = -15% premium, TP1 = +75% premium
- LEVEL setups: qty = 18 contracts, stop = -12% premium, TP1 = +30% premium  
- TRENDLINE setups: stop = -6% premium
- Runner target = 3.0 (trail runner until 3x initial premium reached)
